In 2020, they were playing their third season in the [[Faroe Islands Premier League]], after being promoted from [[1. deild]] after playing there for 1 season in 2017. After the 2020 season they ended as 9th and played a match against [[B68 Toftir]] from 1. deild, the winner would play in the Faroe Islands Premier League for the 2021 season. AB Argir lost the match 2–3 and were relegated to 1. deild. They play their home games at the [[Argir Stadium|Inni í Vika Stadium]] in Argir.
